_comment: Fleet embedding-endpoint registry. Consumed by get_embedding_endpoint() so KG embedding crons never hardcode one host. Any node can serve embeddings (llama-server from SSD + nomic GGUF on SSD); clients fail over to the first reachable endpoint in priority order. Update this file (on SSD, shared across fleet) when you bring a node up/down as an embedding server. The nomic GGUF lives at /media/scott/SSD_4TB/models/nomic-embed-text-v1.5.Q4_K_M.gguf and the portable llama-server binary at /media/scott/SSD_4TB/fleet-tools/llama-server-linux-x86_64-avx2/llama-server.
